Welcome to +1 Speed Obby for Dragon Rider
Complete the stages and grab Dragon!
Avoid the obstacles around the map!
Comeback with your Dragon!
Upgrade your Dragon and get more money!
Rebirth for more cash!
Your Dragon earns cash OFFLINE! 8
Like the game and join the group for FREE EXOTIC Dragon!

We are the developers of +1 Speed Obby for Dragon Rider.

Unfortunately, our original experience was taken down due to some issues, and the previous game database cannot currently be recovered.

To help everyone rebuild their progress as quickly as possible, we plan to increase coin production by 4x until June 30.

Returning players can reach us through our official support channel for verification. Eligible players will receive a return reward.

Thank you again for your continued support.
